crossRefs.note: “ ‘This is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which one shall offer to Yahweh:

translations.web: It shall be eaten the same day you offer it, and on the next day. If anything remains until the third day, it shall be burned with fire.
translations.bsb: It shall be eaten on the day you sacrifice it, or on the next day; but what remains on the third day must be burned up.
translations.kjv: It shall be eaten the same day ye offer it, and on the morrow: and if ought remain until the third day, it shall be burnt in the fire.
translations.asv: It shall be eaten the same day ye offer it, and on the morrow: and if aught remain until the third day, it shall be burnt with fire.
